text:
Maya: Need a short copy pass for the three landing pages today: Hosted API, Dedicated, Private (VPC & on-prem). Must include: single-line hero, one-line benchmark hint, webinar CTA, and form -> routing spec. 11am review.
Carlos: I can join. I have the latest perf snippets and a short bench blurb we can use.
Ivy: I'll draft 2 hero variants per mode and a 1-sentence subhead. Will keep language tight for the hero.
Ben: From ops/legal: use exact product names: "Hosted API", "Redwood Dedicated", and "Private (VPC & on-prem)". Replace "audit logs" with "audit trail" and use "customer-managed keys (CMK)".
PipelineBot: Meeting created: https://calendar.example/evt/4987654321. Reminder 30m.
Maya: Great. For benchmarks, prefer p95 latency for Hosted, tokens/min for Dedicated, and a private note for Private. No public pricing.
Carlos: Suggested copy (short):
Hosted: "Hosted API — production inference, zero infra."
Sub: "p95 ~140ms (chat, 8k) • streaming responses & usage analytics."

Dedicated: "Redwood Dedicated — reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput."
Sub: "Sustained 25k tokens/min per pool • SLA-backed latency."

Private: "Private (VPC & on-prem) — runtime in your network."
Sub: "Customer-managed keys (CMK), audit trail, and on-prem options."

Ivy: CTA options: "Save my seat — live benchmark + Q&A" / "Join demo: performance, rollout, and best practices" / "See it live: Hosted + Dedicated walkthrough"
Maya: First CTA is concise. Add microline under CTA: "Includes benchmark walkthrough and 15-min office hours."
Ben: Routing rules for webinar leads: bucket by employee_count -> {>=1000: enterprise-sales, 200-999: sdr/ae, <200: marketing-nurture}. Also include deployment_interest (hosted/dedicated/private). If deployment_interest=="Private" and employee_count>=500 -> enterprise-sales priority.
Ivy: Sample webhook payload for forms team to wire:
{
  "email": "lead@company.com",
  "name": "Lead Name",
  "company": "Company LLC",
  "employee_count": 1200,
  "deployment_interest": "Dedicated",
  "utm_campaign": "launch-may-2026"
}
Carlos: I'll paste bench doc links after the 10:30 run. Avoid hard $ numbers on public pages.
Maya: Action list: Ivy finalize hero + subhead and single benchmark hint; Carlos confirm canonical bench strings and links; Ben open GH issue for routing mapping; Forms to wire webhook and tag leads with deployment_interest. 11am review: @Carlos @Ivy @Ben.
Ivy: Will post final copy by 10:15 and a quick mock for design.
Ben: Opening the routing GH issue now and tagging eng-forms.
Maya: Thanks team — if we lock this today we can push staging copy and enable the registration CTA. :rocket:
